verdict.rationale: Penpot's docs confirm an inspect feature giving code that matches design (CSS, HTML, SVG, JSON), which covers measurements/styles/code snippets for web, but there is no evidence of iOS/Android-specific code snippet generation, and no explicit documentation confirming that viewers/inspectors can access this without a paid editor seat. missing for 10: iOS/Android code snippet support, explicit seat-free viewer/inspect access confirmation, asset-export detail in inspect mode.
